liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (4 reviews): Reviewer ranks this among the best Truckin's, arguing it deserves a higher spot than its list ranking of 11; Reviewer finds the Truckin' epilogue cheesy and self-indulgent, and the following Other One mediocre [16][17][19][20]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): China>Rider was fun, and the crowd sounds ecstatic afterward; Opening set two with China>Rider was inspired and sent the already-excited crowd soaring [12][14]
- **Wharf Rat** (2 reviews): Band got confused at the end, tried two different songs, and ended up in Sugar Magnolia [16][17]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Singled out as very nice [10]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Over the last third, Jerry takes control and drives it hard into the crowd [14]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): He's Gone > Truckin' > Other One tease > Drums segment is energetic and well played [21]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 other source): Band teased Around and Around just before Sugar Magnolia [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **Bob's Take a Step Back**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **Phil's Take A Step Back**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **Other Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [22]
- **Encore Call**: back after 135 archived shows (584 days); rare: 13 archived performances [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-05-09.nak700.glassberg.motb.85421.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 162 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd79-05-09.naks.seff.4881.sbefixed.shnf**: audience recording; 16 songs; 165 min; rated 3.79/5 by 24 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has plenty of crowd noise but is still very good quality; Audience clapping suits the show; especially noticeable in China>Rider and Sugar Magnolia; Sound quality is fine and the clapping is not annoying [10][12][14][21]
- **gd1979-05-09.177693.nak700.glassberg.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 161 min [3]
- **gd1979-05-09.155839.fob.nak.unknown.ebelgee.flac1648**: source not stated; 17 songs; 166 min [5]. Said about its sound: DAT had static and dropouts in Sugaree, so Sugaree was replaced using the MOTB source [5]
- **gd79-05-09.glassberg.vernon.18875.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 158 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer found Jerry's vocals faint, Phil inaudible and crowd noise heavy on China Cat [15]

## Around the show

- Bob and Phil each told the crowd to take a step back during the first set [1]
- Reviewer says the great shows of 1979 came in the fall; this one is simply fun [20]
- Rated slightly below gold-standard audience tapes like Bertrando's 8/6/71 and the Oades' 11/1/85 [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-05-09.nak700.glassberg.motb.85421.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by A. Egert and B. Koucky; source: Nakamichi CM700's > Sony 158SD > MAC ( > Sony 158SD > C1 ) [1]. Also: Source starts from Barry Glassberg's copy of Bob Wagner's master through Minglewood; the rest is from Glassberg's master [1]
- **gd79-05-09.naks.seff.4881.sbefixed.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff; source: Audience Recording: Naks [2]. Also: Reviewer had an audience cassette copy of set two from about three months after the show; this download comes from same master; Taped by Naks on a Teac PC-10 cassette, then DAT; transferred and seeded by Jon Seff; Transfer used DA-20mkII into Delta DiO 2496 and Peak; Set II downsampled; flips after Minglewood and Drums [2][13]
- **gd1979-05-09.177693.nak700.glassberg.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Barry Glassberg's Master Audience Cassettes: Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-158SD (Maxell UDXL II) [3]
- **gd1979-05-09.155839.fob.nak.unknown.ebelgee.flac1648**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: FOB NAK 700-> Cassette-> DAT [5]. Also: Cassette-to-DAT transfer at 48k; set one lacks the deck pauses found in other tapes [5]
- **gd79-05-09.glassberg.vernon.18875.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by John Steinthal; source: Audience Recording [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LUV4MUSIC!: [Spotlight On What I Am Listening To: Grateful Dead - Broome County Arena, Binghamton, NY 1979-05-09 AUD - LUV4MUSIC!](https://www.luv4music.org/2026/05/09/spotlight-on-what-i-am-listening-to-grateful-dead-broome-county-arena-binghamton-ny-1979-05-09-aud/) [23]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Broome County Arena - May 9, 1979](https://www.dead.net/show/may-9-1979) [24]
- Poster by Jerrybase: [Grateful Dead – 1979-05-09](https://jerrybase.com/events/19790509-01) [25]
